title: Differentiable Learning of Lifted Action Schemas for Classical Planning
abstract: arXiv:2605.13282v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classical planners can effectively solve very large deterministic MDPs represented in STRIPS or PDDL where states are sets of atoms over objects and relations, and lifted action schemas add or delete these atoms. This compact representation yields strong search heuristics and provides an ideal setting for structural generalization, since lifted relations and action schemas give rise to infinitely many domain instances. A central challenge is to learn these relations and action schemas from data, and recent approaches have addressed this problem using different types of observations. In this work, we develop a novel neural network architecture for learning action schemas from traces where states are fully observed but action arguments are unobserved. translated_title: 面向经典规划的提升动作模式可微分学习
translated_abstract: 经典规划器能够有效求解以 STRIPS 或 PDDL 表示的超大规模确定性 MDP，其中状态是关于对象和关系的原子集合，而提升动作模式则对这些原子进行添加或删除。这种紧凑的表示方式能够产生强大的搜索启发式方法，并为结构泛化提供了理想的环境，因为提升的关系和动作模式可以生成无限多个领域实例。一个核心挑战是从数据中学习这些关系和动作模式，近期的方法已经使用不同类型的观测来解决这一问题。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种新颖的神经网络架构，用于从轨迹中学习动作模式，其中状态是完全可观测的，但动作参数是不可观测的。这个问题是一种简化，但它是从图像序列和动作标签中学习规划领域的重要一步，我们旨在几乎完美地解决这一简化问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖的神经网络架构，能够以可微分的方式从状态完全可观测但动作参数不可观测的轨迹中学习经典规划的提升动作模式，为从图像序列学习规划领域奠定了重要基础。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel neural network architecture for differentiable learning of lifted action schemas for classical planning from traces where states are fully observed but action arguments are unobserved, serving as an important step toward learning planning domains from image sequences.
